name: Weighted Icon Randomizer
description: Randomizes only the player's cube after death using weighted selections.

enabled.name: Enable randomizer
enabled.description: Choose a new cube after each player death.

avoid-repeat.name: Avoid immediate repeat
avoid-repeat.description: Exclude the previously selected cube when another enabled, positive-weight entry exists.

cube-list.name: Cube entries
cube-list.description: Configure vanilla and More Icons cube entries, weights, and enabled state.

test.name: Test randomize
test.description: Run the weighted selector immediately. This is useful for testing without dying.
